info.title: Logto API (Mock)
info.description: Mock of Logto. Two planes: /oidc/* is an OAuth 2.0 authorization server whose token endpoint takes a grant_type, a resource indicator and a scope and mints an access token bound to that resource (RFC 6749 error bodies); /api/* is the Management API, itself just another protected resource, reachable only with a bearer issued FOR https://default.logto.app/api and carrying a wide enough scope (Logto {code, message} error bodies). Organization tokens carry the audience urn:logto:organization:<id>.

get.description:
Return captured request/response logs.

WARNING: the unpaginated default response embeds a full copy of every
response body seen this session and grows without bound — late in a
session it can exceed what client tooling returns intact (long output
is often silently capped). Prefer `/audit/summary` for an overview, or
page through with `limit`/`offset` and `include_body=false` (drops the
bulky `response_body` field; `request_body` is always kept).

Defaults (no params = full dump, bodies included) are kept for
compatibility with the grading harness, which reads this endpoint
parameter-less and asserts on response_body content.
Clear the request log. Returns count of cleared entries.
Return aggregated summary of API usage.

post.description:
The token endpoint.

Real clients post `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`; the mock accepts JSON
with the same field names so the collection stays readable.

get.description:
Read the organization an organization token is scoped to.

This is the only endpoint that accepts an organization token rather than a
Management API token, so it demonstrates the other audience.
